definition: An agent edit or patch leaves Python or patch syntax invalid.
decision_test: Use when the decisive error is a syntax, indentation, or malformed-patch error in agent-authored code or patch text.
example: E2-028: IndentationError: expected an indented block after 'if' statement

definition: An agent evaluator patch implements its data handling or logic incorrectly.
decision_test: Use when the decisive error is in an agent-authored evaluator repair, rather than a library API removed from unchanged reference code.
example: E2-099: ValueError: cannot set a frame with no defined columns

definition: Agent-written code calls an unavailable or inappropriate API.
decision_test: Use when the failed API call is in agent-written code or a separate agent checker, rather than unchanged reference code running under an incompatible library version.
example: E2-135: AttributeError: 'mmap.mmap' object has no attribute 'count'

definition: An agent-written checker applies an invalid validation rule.
decision_test: Use when a separate checker fails because its assertion, comparison, or validation logic is wrong.

definition: Code the agent wrote to replace a removed file passes or returns a type, shape, index, checkpoint, or model object that the retained caller or LoadGen does not accept.
decision_test: Use when agent-authored replacement code passes or returns a type, shape, index, checkpoint, or model object rejected by the retained caller or LoadGen; do not use for a removed file merely being read.
example: E2-197: IndexError: list index out of range

definition: The selected or activated interpreter lacks a required module or selects the wrong environment.
decision_test: Use when selecting or activating another available interpreter or environment completes the same operation.
example: E2-041: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'torch'

definition: The agent selects an interpreter version incompatible with the required pinned stack.
decision_test: Use when dependency resolution or build fails because the selected interpreter version is unsupported and a compatible available interpreter resolves it.
example: E2-121: error: No solution found when resolving dependencies

definition: The agent invokes conda activation before the shell has initialized conda.
decision_test: Use when the decisive error asks for conda initialization and the corrected shell activation completes.
example: E2-220: CondaError: Run 'conda init' before 'conda activate'

definition: The agent supplies a nonexistent file, directory, interpreter, or working-directory path.
decision_test: Use when correcting the selected path completes the operation; use relative-path-from-wrong-directory when the path would work from the correct current directory.
example: E2-194: /usr/bin/bash: ../../../compat-venv/bin/python: No such file or directory

definition: A relative path resolves from the wrong working directory.
decision_test: Use when the same relative path would locate its target from the correct directory or after the agent makes the path absolute.
example: E3-075: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '../preflight/preprocessed/preprocessed_files.pkl'

definition: Shell quoting leaves a required variable literal instead of expanding it.
decision_test: Use when a literal variable name appears in the failing path and changing shell expansion completes the operation.
example: E2-216: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '$BENCH_DIR/inference_utils.py'

definition: The agent command reads a required shell variable before setting it.
decision_test: Use when an unbound-variable error names a required runtime variable and defining it completes the command.
example: E2-107: KITS19_RAW_DIR: unbound variable

definition: A shell assignment is written where the command should be invoked.
decision_test: Use when the shell reports an assignment or variable-derived command name as not found.
example:
E2-049: {"chunk_id":"91e897","wall_time_seconds":5.862192978,"exit_code":127,"original_token_count":84,"output":"Installed 1 package in 181ms
 + pydicom==2.4.4
1.23.5 1.9.3 3.2.1 1.5.3 2.4.4 2.6.0+cu124
/usr/bin/bash: line 6: env-test-python=/sfs/gpfs/tardis/project/MLSys/mlperf-c0-c6/runs/3d-unet-kits19-v2/c1/plain-2026-11-12-12-48-53/ws/env-test/bin/python: No such file or directory
/usr/bin/bash: line 7: -test-python: command not found
"}

definition: A reproduction script's shell startup command fails under strict shell mode.
decision_test: Use when a startup or profile command under set -e or set -u exits the reproduce script before its work begins.
example: E2-255: -source /etc/profile >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

definition: A bounded preflight retains a full-dataset checksum manifest.
decision_test: Use when a bounded reproduce.sh preflight uses fewer cases but leaves the full checksum manifest and the manifest cardinality causes the failure.
example: E2-019: AssertionError: checksum.json has 43 entries while 1 volumes found

definition: A reproduce.sh preflight passes an invalid or empty case selection.
decision_test: Use when the preflight's case argument or selected case set is invalid independently of its checksum manifest.
example: E3-065: unknown preflight case: .

definition: A reproduction script orders stages or output setup incorrectly.
decision_test: Use when a benchmark or bounded preflight fails because a directory, log, or prerequisite is used before the script creates it, or a completed-stage guard exits under set -e.
example: E3-101: tee: 3d-unet/preflight_driver.log: No such file or directory

definition: An inspection command treats a supplied source snapshot as a Git checkout.
decision_test: Use when a Git metadata command runs against a supplied snapshot without a .git directory; it is Inspection unless the command is part of reproduce.sh.
example: E2-001: fatal: not a git repository (or any parent up to mount point /sfs/gpfs)

definition: An agent command wrapper invokes a Git subcommand as a shell command.
decision_test: Use when the wrapper omits the git executable or otherwise constructs a Git command incorrectly.
example: E3-127: /usr/bin/bash: rev-parse: command not found

definition: An agent patch targets text no longer present in the target file.
decision_test: Use when apply_patch reports expected context missing from an agent-selected current file.
example: E2-036: apply_patch verification failed: Failed to find expected lines

definition: An agent probe or script assumes an unsupported representation of supplied data.
decision_test: Use when the supplied artifact has a different schema and the failing operation is an agent-authored read or checker.
example: E2-251: AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'keys'

definition: The selected library version removed an API used by the unchanged reference.
decision_test: Use when the reference runs with an obtainable compatible library stack and the decisive error names a removed or moved library API.
example: E2-045: AttributeError: module 'scipy.signal' has no attribute 'gaussian'

definition: The selected serialization stack changes preprocessed pickle bytes from historical checksums.
decision_test: Use when bytewise preprocessing checksum verification fails under the selected stack and a compatible stack or scientific-content check resolves it.
example: E2-002: AssertionError: Verification failed, 1/1 mismatch(es) found

definition: The selected versions of two required libraries are incompatible.
decision_test: Use when an import or API error is caused by the combination of selected library versions rather than by the selected interpreter alone.
example: E2-048: ImportError: cannot import name 'read_file' from 'pydicom.dicomio'

definition: The selected build environment lacks a development header needed to build a dependency.
decision_test: Use when the failure names a missing development header in an agent-selected build environment.
example: E2-108: Python.h: No such file or directory

definition: The agent attempts to create a virtual environment at an already occupied path.
decision_test: Use when virtual-environment creation fails because the agent selected an existing target path.
example: E2-204: Failed to create virtual environment

definition: The selected interpreter rejects package installation because its environment is externally managed.
decision_test: Use when the decisive installer diagnostic identifies an externally managed environment and selecting or creating an appropriate environment completes the operation.
example: E4-001: externally-managed-environment

definition: An agent command has shell syntax that prevents the shell from parsing it.
decision_test: Use when the decisive shell diagnostic identifies an unmatched quote
example: unterminated construct
column9: E4-002: unexpected EOF while looking for matching quote

definition: A reproduce.sh invocation receives arguments outside its declared interface.
decision_test: Use when reproduce.sh prints its usage or rejects an unrecognized or incompatible argument combination and a valid invocation completes the operation.
example: E4-003: usage: ./reproduce.sh --target bert-squad

definition: Unchanged reference code fails at a value or line removed from the supplied reference.
decision_test: Use when retained reference execution reaches a removed value or line; do not use when the call only reads or opens a removed file.
example: E2-087: AssertionError: Need proper target spacing: None

definition: A call reads or opens a file removed from the supplied reference.
decision_test: Use when the failed operation is reading or opening the removed file itself; do not use when retained reference execution fails at a removed value or line.
example: E2-088: FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory

definition: A required system utility is unavailable on the host platform.
decision_test: Use when the host lacks a system tool and changing agent code to another available tool or obtaining the tool is required.
example: E2-212: jq: command not found

definition: An agent-selected package pin cannot be resolved because the required artifact is excluded by a cutoff or absent from the offline cache.
decision_test: Use when full resolver output names the selected package or pin and says no matching artifact exists under an exclude-newer cutoff or that the required artifact must be downloaded but is missing from the cache with network disabled; do not use when it explicitly identifies interpreter incompatibility or library-version incompatibility.
example: E4-017: no version of nvidia-cuda-nvrtc-cu12 was available for the selected pin

definition: The selected runtime environment lacks a required shared library needed by an imported package.
decision_test: Use when the decisive error names a missing .so or shared object during import or execution and does not itself report a version incompatibility.
example: E4-031: ImportError: libnvJitLink.so.12: cannot open shared object file

definition: A selected input path contains a symbolic-link cycle or excessive symbolic-link recursion.
decision_test: Use when the decisive error explicitly reports too many levels of symbolic links while copying or resolving the selected path.
example: E4-058: Errno 40 Too many levels of symbolic links

definition: A host-shared cache is read-only.
decision_test: Use when the same operation completes after the agent redirects the cache to a writable local location, not after changing sandbox permissions.
example: E3-067: Could not acquire lock

definition: The tool layer rejects a command before it runs because of policy.
decision_test: Use when the tool or harness refusal is decisive and no corresponding benchmark command executes.
example: E2-078: rejected: rm -f style commands are not permitted

definition: The tool layer loses an active process or execution cell.
decision_test: Use when the tool layer loses a process or cell before its completion can be observed; do not use for a poll of a process or cell already known to be finished.
example: E2-188: write_stdin failed: Unknown process id 88571

definition: The sandbox prevents access to the GPU or its driver.
decision_test: Use when the unchanged command reaches the GPU outside the sandbox or after sandbox permission changes.
example: E3-097: NVIDIA-SMI has failed because it couldn't communicate with the NVIDIA driver. Make sure that the latest NVIDIA driver is installed and running.

definition: The sandbox prevents a cache write that succeeds after a sandbox permission change.
decision_test: Use when the unchanged operation retains the same shared cache but succeeds after only tool-layer or sandbox permissions change.
example: E3-054: error: Could not acquire lock

definition: The failed call is recorded but its retained output does not show the cause.
decision_test: Use when a failed call is recorded but its retained output does not show what failed; do not infer a specific contract category or root cause from the exit status alone.
example: E4-000: recorded failed call with no retained diagnostic
